name: m34-attempt-write-unconditional
rationale: attempts 续期写不再条件判定 ⇒ 陈旧快照复活已投递条目（假 ERROR，W3）
old:
applied = self._quarantine_cond_update(
            event_id,
            lambda m: m.update({"attempts": attempts, "due_ms": due_ms}),
        )
new:
if self.redis_client is not None:
            self.redis_client.hset(QUARANTINE_KEY, event_id, json.dumps({"ts": 0.0, "first_seen": time.time(), "attempts": attempts, "due_ms": due_ms, "reason": "x", "state": "pending"}))
